# matthewguo.me

Personal site of Matthew Guo, hardware and systems engineer in Mountain View, CA.

- MCP server (Streamable HTTP, no auth): https://matthewguo.me/mcp
  Tools: about, experience, capabilities (tree; dotted paths), search, projects, links, availability, request_call, contact.
  GET the endpoint for a JSON description of the tools.
- Walkable without MCP: https://matthewguo.me/p (index; every page links its children). One-file versions: /profile.md and /profile.json
- Contact and scheduling only work through the MCP tools.
